about: I'm an animation and 3D computer graphics practitioner based in Surabaya, Indonesia, holding a background from SMKN 2 Surabaya (Jurusan Animasi). Since 2020, I have immersed myself in the art of 3D modeling, hard-surface precision, architectural rendering, and digital world-building.

Over the past few years, I have executed more than 10 freelance 3D commissions for international clients, delivering game-ready props, stylized fantasy dioramas, and photorealistic architectural visualizations (Archviz) using Blender, Autodesk Maya, and Substance 3D Painter.

What sets my work apart is my cross-disciplinary versatility: alongside 3D and CGI, I create high-impact graphic campaigns and video productions (having directed 30+ property reels and marketing assets at PT Wong Bejo Joyo), as well as interactive UI/UX interfaces for game HUDs and modern web platforms. I thrive at the frontier where visual art meets functional software.

experience.description: Completed over 10 international 3D modeling and visualization projects. Created game-ready low-poly and stylized 3D assets, modular environment sets, and architectural renderings. Managed the end-to-end pipeline from conceptual geometry and high-to-low poly baking to UV unwrap, PBR texturing, and photorealistic lighting.

experience.role: Multimedia Designer — Graphic Design & Video Editing
experience.description: Produced and edited 30+ high-production real estate video reels and commercial marketing campaigns for Instagram and TikTok. Spearheaded weekly creative direction, visual pacing, sound design, and graphic promotional templates.

Regular participant in global 3D modeling challenges, topology reviews, and asset critiques within the Blender community. Active contributor in the Hidden Dev community, collaborating on web UI/UX projects, automation tools, and front-end code experiments.
